title: The Claiborne Williams band: size, style and family
summary: Claiborne Williams led one of the best bands in the South, a reading orchestra of about 14 with violins; his son George played trumpet and daughter Mary piano.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
